records.verificationNote: Read pages 43 and 44: LANTUS SoloStar U-100 pen and vial, Tier 3, CI and MO, no PA/ST. Page 10 defines CI as Part D covered insulin products. LANTUS was picked as the basal preferred agent because it is the most-prescribed basal product of the covered basal lines; no generic glargine is on the list, so boglActive false. Basaglar, Semglee, Rezvoglar, Humalog, Admelog and Lyumjev do not appear on the list. The document does not state the list is complete, so these are not recorded as excluded; partial because the preferred basal pick could differ if one of them is covered. Humulin R U-500 (page 43, Tier 5, DL) is a concentrated regular insulin and excluded from the basal alternatives. Soliqua (page 44) is a glargine-lixisenatide combination and excluded. [Reused: same national Humana Premier Rx PDP formulary as the TX guide (2026-10-21)]
